name: agent-workflow
description: How work is run: best-practices, learning-loop (capture, curate, promote), model-delegation, visual-loop (show design options on the real thing and loop), token-efficiency (fewer turns and tokens for the same work), session-continuity (keep long work alive across compactions), actions-cost (runner-minutes before a merge), netlify-cost (Netlify builds, credits and edge runs before a config change), and the cheap-reviewer subagent.
